dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Hello. It's an honor to be invited into your home.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: It's even better than I imagined.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: I really appreciate the way this space combines popular aesthetics with your own personal style. Such a pleasant surprise.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: Decorating is not one of my areas of expertise, I'm afraid. Although, I could certainly give you some advice on keeping the place well-ventilated, if you want.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: The ventilation system I use in my perfume studio is one that I designed myself. As you can imagine, a perfume studio has more stringent ventilation requirements than other indoor spaces.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: Beyond that, it's worth giving some serious consideration to the position of doors and windows. Of course, these are just suggestions. If you have friends with more relevant expertise, you should ask them, too.

choices.text: Could you recommend some fragrances to suit this place?

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: Hmm... For a place like this, I would recommend an herbal fragrance.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: It would fit with the overall openness of the space, and bring in some of the earthy notes of the natural environment. Also, considering your occupation, it suits you down to a T.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Occupation? You mean, being a traveler?

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: Exactly. From what I've seen, at least, that seems to be your primary occupation.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: In my experience, travelers who spend a long time on the road have a better memory for scents than the average person.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: And ultimately, it all stems from the ground beneath your feet — the soil. That's where you spend every step of your journey, from start to finish.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: Herbal notes capture the essence of the natural environment. They're most suited to people with the deepest connection to the land.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have time for a chat?

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Of course. As long as I'm not keeping you from anything.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Why don't you pick a topic?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would this place work as a perfume studio?

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Ah, well, since you asked... Forgive me for being blunt, but I'm afraid not. The scenery here makes it a great place to live. But, it's missing quite a few necessities as far as a perfume studio is concerned.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Perfumes have very strict storage requirements. It takes a lot of dedicated equipment.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Of course, there's nothing stopping you from bringing the place up to spec. If you did that, it could make a fine studio space indeed.

choices.text: You seem like you're good at focusing.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: Well, I'd have to agree with you there. It's very true.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: My work requires a high degree of precision. So, it's a good thing that I excel at staying focused.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: Staying focused for three to five hours at a time is pretty easy for me.

choices.text: Got any tips for improving concentration?

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: You're not the first person to ask me that question. Some people even believe certain perfumes can help you stay alert or increase productivity.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: But, unfortunately, that's just wishful thinking.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: Certain fragrances can have a temporary relaxing effect on people, but long-term exposure to strong scents actually has a negative effect on the brain.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: If you want my personal opinion, beyond being well-rested and sober, the best way to improve concentration is to minimize exposure to external stimuli.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: Before you begin a task, you need to remove all distractions and make sure your environment is suited to long hours of uninterrupted work.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: If you ignore those two factors, you're setting yourself up for failure, no matter what your mental state is.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: The way you've designed this courtyard is quite ingenious. You could grow all kinds of plants.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: I'd like to try cultivating some plant specimens — with your permission, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will they be fragrant?

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Some of them will.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: But plants that don't give off a strong fragrance are equally important.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Some plants don't have a distinct scent of their own, but can neutralize or modify other aromas. So they're often used to fine-tune a fragrance and control the intensity.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds almost like an experiment...

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Well, perfume-making is an experiment, and each ingredient is a different variable.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Hence why finding a suitable place to grow those ingredients is so important.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: The same ingredient will exhibit different properties in different environments. That's true for minerals and animal secretions, as well as plants.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: It looks like you have the capacity to adjust certain environmental parameters in this marvelous little courtyard of yours. Which means, all different kinds of flora and fauna can grow in an environment suited to them.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: It's like you have a courtyard-sized petri dish at your disposal. I can think of some other experiments you could run here, too... But those are forensics-related. They have to do with identification and cleaning.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: And private residences aren't really the best places to run those sorts of experiments. I don't want to ruin the lovely environment you have going here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds kinda cool, though...

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Haha, then you're welcome to visit my laboratory any time.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: I heard you're an experienced alchemist, amongst other things? Perhaps we can trade expertise.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Great! You're welcome here any time, as well.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Thank you! I'll certainly take you up on that invitation.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: This place is like an amalgamation of all your travels and everything you've experienced in life...

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Perhaps, one day, a perfume will be made that perfectly encapsulates the unique character of this place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Emilie.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Good Morning. Looks like you're ready to head out for the day.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Then, I won't take up any more of your time. Good luck with your endeavors.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodnight, Emilie.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: By the looks of it, you've had quite a big day today. You should get some rest.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: There are a lot of houses and gardens like this on the outskirts of Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Bright colors and fragrant flowers always have this way of washing away the exhaustion of travel.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Every time I come across something like this on the road, I always make sure to stop and appreciate it for a little while.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Have you ever heard the saying, "All water in Fontaine converges in the Fountain of Lucine"?

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Sometimes, I wonder about the water used to wash away the remnants of the dead... Does it carry traces of their resentment away with it?

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Anyway, your fountain is quite different. The water is so much cleaner without all those coins people throw in to make wishes.
